comment: Official glossary term. Keep the loanword; adjective form фракциялық.
Official glossary term: семья = отбасы in every screen (family chat; safe; upgrades). Not жанұя/әулет.
Premium currency. Keep the Latin brand spelling; players say ГК or GC. A suffix goes after a hyphen: Grand Coins-ті.
Official glossary term. Player-owned business; кәсіпорын is a factory/enterprise (предприятие).
Player slang for an administrator warning. Accepted in admin/chat UI; formal: ескерту.
Player slang for a chat mute (admin punishment). Keep мут.
Heavy truck (trucker job; loading screens). Players say фура; жүк көлігі is the neutral form.
Account ban by an administrator. бұғаттау (block) is accepted for formal UI.
Dominant form in the file (22 keys); тіркелгі (5 keys) and есептік жазба are accepted. Bare есеп means count/report.
Game administrators; админ is the usual player word.
Player report to administrators (slang). шағым is the formal complaint.
Loot case. Never іс (a legal case or matter).
Character or vehicle skin. Never тері (animal hide).
Real-money top-up and donate currency. Keep донат.
Season pass written in Russian. Pick one form; сезондық пас and мезгілдік are also in use.

comment: Generic reward. Several synonyms are in use; prefer сыйлық.
Vehicle. автокөлік and машина are accepted.
Player inventory. Never түгендеу or инвентаризация (stock-taking).
Player character. персонаж is accepted; таңба means a text symbol.
Rank. дәреже is accepted; рейтинг is a different term (rating).
Bet. бәс is accepted (бәс тігу = to bet).
Inventory item. бұйым is accepted; пән means a school subject.
Settings screen (dominant form). параметрлер is a different word choice; keep one.
Contract. контракт and келісім are accepted.
Booster. The loanword is preferred; күшейткіш is an accepted Kazakh rendering.
Premium tier. Latin Premium is kept inside brand names.
In-game event. іс-шара is accepted; оқиға means an occurrence.
Vehicle fuel. жанармай and бензин are accepted.
Limit. шектеу is an accepted Kazakh rendering.
Shop goods. зат (item) is accepted in purchase confirmations.
